text.p: DiversiFax Inc said Tuesday it has signed an exclusive five-year agreement with Nanomach, a Lichtenstein-based technology company, to distribute that firm's ScreenScan products in the U.S.

ScreenScan is a technology that converts the analog output of common microform reader/printers into digital form, so that use of existing microform reader/printers is easier, more economical, and compatible with popular laser printers for high quality digital output, a statement from DiversiFax said.

DiversiFax supplies a range of products and services to public libraries, colleges, government offices, and other institutional markets where a large base of analog microform reader/printers remain in service.

The products will be distributed by DigiPrint, a wholly owned subsidiary of DiversiFax based in Valley Stream, N.Y. First shipments of the products are expected to be available in the U.S. during the third week in October, DiversiFax said.
